groups.name: iqkv.db
groups.description: Intermediary database connection properties. Values are composed into spring.datasource by profile ymls.

groups.name: iqkv.rabbitmq
groups.description: Intermediary RabbitMQ connection properties. Values are composed into spring.rabbitmq by profile ymls.

groups.name: iqkv.mail
groups.description: Intermediary mail connection properties. Values are composed into spring.mail and iqkv.notification.mail.

groups.name: iqkv.platform
groups.description: Platform-wide operational settings. Must be consistent across all core services (IAM, Billing, Gateway).

groups.name: iqkv.billing
groups.description: Billing-specific configuration. Provides fallback values for single-tenant mode.

groups.name: iqkv.billing.plan-catalog
groups.description: Config-driven plan catalog — the single source of truth for plan definitions. Read by BillingSeedRunner at startup and loaded into memory by PlanFeatureRegistry.

groups.name: iqkv.payment.gateway
groups.description: Active payment gateway selection. Determines which PaymentGatewayPort adapter is used at runtime.

groups.name: iqkv.stripe
groups.description: Stripe adapter configuration. Required when iqkv.payment.gateway.type=STRIPE.

groups.name: iqkv.lemon-squeezy
groups.description: Lemon Squeezy adapter configuration. Required when iqkv.payment.gateway.type=LEMON_SQUEEZY.

groups.name: iqkv.auth.jwt
groups.description: JWT token verification settings. Exactly one of jwks-uri or public-key-path must be set.

groups.name: iqkv.liquibase
groups.description: Tenant-aware Liquibase migration configuration consumed by the foundation-tenancy TenantLiquibaseRunner.

properties.name: iqkv.db.host
properties.description: Database server hostname.

properties.name: iqkv.db.port
properties.description: Database server port.

properties.name: iqkv.db.name
properties.description: Database name.

properties.name: iqkv.db.username
properties.description: Database username.

properties.name: iqkv.db.password
properties.description: Database password.

properties.name: iqkv.rabbitmq.host
properties.description: RabbitMQ broker hostname.

properties.name: iqkv.rabbitmq.port
properties.description: RabbitMQ broker AMQP port.

properties.name: iqkv.rabbitmq.username
properties.description: RabbitMQ username.

properties.name: iqkv.rabbitmq.password
properties.description: RabbitMQ password.

properties.name: iqkv.mail.host
properties.description: SMTP server hostname.

properties.name: iqkv.mail.port
properties.description: SMTP server port.

properties.name: iqkv.mail.username
properties.description: SMTP authentication username.

properties.name: iqkv.mail.password
properties.description: SMTP authentication password.

properties.name: iqkv.mail.from
properties.description: Default From address for outgoing emails.

properties.name: iqkv.mail.from-name
properties.description: Display name for the From address in outgoing emails.

properties.name: iqkv.mail.reply-to
properties.description: Default Reply-To address for outgoing emails.

properties.name: iqkv.platform.rollout-mode
properties.description: Platform-wide operational mode. Must match across all core services. MULTI_TENANT: subscriptions are scoped per tenant; owner fields required in tenant.created events. SINGLE_TENANT: subscriptions are scoped per user; owner fields optional in tenant.created events.

properties.name: iqkv.billing.default-contact-email
properties.description: Fallback billing contact email for SINGLE_TENANT mode. Used when tenant.created event has no ownerEmail. Fallback chain: (1) ownerEmail from event → (2) this value → (3) null (payment gateway customer created without email). Required when gateway.type=LEMON_SQUEEZY and platform.rollout-mode=SINGLE_TENANT.

properties.name: iqkv.billing.grace-period-days
properties.description: Length of the payment grace period (days) for past_due renewals before access is suspended.

properties.name: iqkv.billing.max-payment-retries
properties.description: Maximum gateway payment retry attempts tracked during the grace period.

properties.name: iqkv.billing.plan-catalog.products
properties.description: Map of plan definitions keyed by product id. Each entry defines planCode, displayName, billingPeriod (MONTHLY|ANNUAL), priceMinor, currency, scope (TENANT|USER), active, trialPeriodDays, pricingModel (FLAT|PER_SEAT|METERED), optional externalVariantId (Lemon Squeezy), optional metering tiers and an entitlement block (maxUsers, maxProjects, features; 0 = unlimited).

properties.name: iqkv.payment.gateway.type
properties.description: Active payment gateway adapter. Determines which PaymentGatewayPort implementation is used.

properties.name: iqkv.stripe.secret-key
properties.description: Stripe API secret key. Required when iqkv.payment.gateway.type=STRIPE. Use test keys (sk_test_*) for development, live keys (sk_live_*) for production.

properties.name: iqkv.stripe.webhook-secret
properties.description: Stripe webhook signing secret. Required when iqkv.payment.gateway.type=STRIPE. Used to verify webhook event signatures at POST /api/v1/billing/webhooks/stripe.

properties.name: iqkv.stripe.portal-return-url
properties.description: URL to redirect users back to after they leave the Stripe Customer Portal.

properties.name: iqkv.lemon-squeezy.api-key
properties.description: Lemon Squeezy API key. Required when iqkv.payment.gateway.type=LEMON_SQUEEZY.

properties.name: iqkv.lemon-squeezy.store-id
properties.description: Numeric Lemon Squeezy store id. Required when iqkv.payment.gateway.type=LEMON_SQUEEZY.

properties.name: iqkv.lemon-squeezy.webhook-secret
properties.description: Lemon Squeezy webhook signing secret. Required when iqkv.payment.gateway.type=LEMON_SQUEEZY.

properties.name: iqkv.lemon-squeezy.portal-return-url
properties.description: URL to redirect users back to after they leave the Lemon Squeezy customer portal.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.jwt.jwks-uri
properties.description: JWKS URI of the IAM service. Preferred in deployed (K8s) environments; keys are fetched, cached and refreshed automatically on rotation. Mutually exclusive with public-key-path. Example: http://foundation-iam-service/.well-known/jwks.json

properties.name: iqkv.auth.jwt.public-key-path
properties.description: Path to the RSA public key PEM file used for verifying JWTs. Supports classpath: and file: prefixes. Used for local development and tests; ignored when jwks-uri is set.

properties.name: iqkv.messaging.rabbitmq.enabled
properties.description: Enables RabbitMQ messaging. When false, all AMQP beans are skipped (used in test profile).

properties.name: iqkv.notification.mail.from
properties.description: From address used in outgoing notification emails. Resolved from iqkv.mail.from.

properties.name: iqkv.notification.mail.from-name
properties.description: Display name for the From address in outgoing notification emails. Resolved from iqkv.mail.from-name.

properties.name: iqkv.notification.mail.reply-to
properties.description: Reply-To address used in outgoing notification emails. Resolved from iqkv.mail.reply-to.

properties.name: iqkv.notification.mail.provider
properties.description: Active email transport provider: 'smtp' or 'resend'.

properties.name: iqkv.notification.mail.resend.api-key
properties.description: Resend API key. Required when iqkv.notification.mail.provider=resend.

properties.name: iqkv.notification.default-locale
properties.description: Default locale for notification templates. Must be a valid BCP 47 language tag (e.g. en, en-US).

properties.name: iqkv.notification.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the frontend application, used to construct links in notification emails.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.tenant-runner-enabled
properties.description: Registers the foundation-tenancy TenantLiquibaseRunner so pending changesets are applied to every tenant schema on startup.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.system-change-log
properties.description: Classpath location of the system (public schema) Liquibase changelog.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.tenant-change-log
properties.description: Classpath location of the per-tenant schema Liquibase changelog.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.change-log
properties.description: Master Liquibase changelog location. Kept for compatibility with the base application.yml; the tenant runner uses system-change-log.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.contexts
properties.description: Active Liquibase contexts. Set to 'demo' on non-production profiles to apply demo seed changelogs; omit for schema-only.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.bootstrap-tenants
properties.description: Tenant keys whose schemas are migrated during bootstrap, in addition to the system schema.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.upgrade-existing-tenants
properties.description: Whether the TenantLiquibaseRunner scans and upgrades already-provisioned tenant schemas on startup.
